title: ATP DNS Policy v1.0
description: JSON Schema for the Agent Trust Protocol (ATP/1) policy record, parsed from a DNS TXT record at _aria-policy.<host> (looked up host first, then apex). The record informs agents; the receiver's configured policy decides and MUST match it. Parameter classes: normative (v, min, req, deny, intent, depth, fresh, enforce), informative (rua, rate). qualify is reserved and never evaluated in ATP/1; unknown parameters are ignored unless prefixed with ! (critical). Normative reference: https://aria.bar/spec#atp. Unknown parameters are permitted and ignored, per ATP/1 §3: a processor ignores what it does not understand unless the name is written with a leading '!' (critical), in which case it MUST treat the policy as unsatisfiable. This schema therefore validates the known set and never rejects a record for carrying a name it has not heard of.

min.description: Minimum trust level required for agent admission. L0=Anchored, L1=Identified, L2=Certified, L3=Sovereign.

enforce.description: Enforcement mode: monitor (evaluate, log, admit all) · warn (admit, add warning) · strict (deny). Mandatory in a published record; absent in configuration = strict.

items.description: Required scope pattern. Supports wildcards: 'commerce:order:*' matches any scope beginning with 'commerce.'.

req.description: Required scopes, AND semantics. Comma-separated list of ARIA scopes: three colon-separated segments namespace:resource:action, wildcard only as the whole last segment (commerce:order:*).

items.description: Prohibited scope pattern. Agent carrying any listed scope is rejected or flagged.

deny.description: Prohibited scopes, same grammar as req. Any intersection with the agent's effective scope set denies (ATP-406/SCOPE-DENIED).

items.description: Intent Declaration field name that must be present in the agent's intent payload.

intent.description: Additional Intent Declaration fields required on top of the protocol minimum (purpose, action_requested, principal_ref). principal_ref is always a DID, never a name (ATP-13, COM-09).

depth.description: Maximum delegation depth: credentialSubject.delegationDepth of the AID (signed by the issuer) must be ≤ this value (ATP-462).

rate.description: Declared call limit (informative). Not evaluated by the admission algorithm; rate enforcement is receiver infrastructure. ATP-429 is emitted outside the algorithm.

rua.description: URI for aggregate evaluation reports (informative; DMARC rua= pattern). Does not affect admission.

fresh.description: Maximum age of the AID status evidence at decision time and during the session. Default 3600s. Floor 60s (COM-05): lower values are a configuration error. Stale evidence that cannot be renewed denies (ATP-412).

qualify.description: Reserved in ATP/1 and never evaluated: it depends on Trust Seals (spec Appendix C), which are not implemented. Declared here so the reserved name is visible; a processor treats it by the unknown-parameter rule below.
